name: bitserializer
description: C++17 serialization to JSON/JSONC, XML, YAML, CSV and MsgPack via one API, with self-contained built-in formats and optional fast_float acceleration.

fast-float.description: Use fast_float for faster floating-point parsing

pugixml-archive.description: Module for support XML (implementation based on the PugiXml library)

rapidjson-archive.description: Module for support JSON (deprecated; use json-archive instead)

rapidyaml-archive.description: Module for support YAML (implementation based on the RapidYaml library)
